data.playStyle: Advanced attacking players, and collectors who want a piece of Ale Galán history.
data.summary: The Metalbone Master LTD is the exclusive, limited-edition racket made with the essence that took Ale Galán to world No. 1. It combines a diamond power shape, adjustable balance and a premium carbon build, delivered in a special collector's box.
data.description:
This is the racket adidas made for the best: a limited run built around Ale Galán's game. The diamond mould and high balance deliver the punch of one of the most powerful arms on tour, while the adjustable Weight & Balance System lets you shift the feel from all-out power towards more control.

The Octagonal Structure stiffens the frame at impact, and the soft EVA core keeps contact comfortable. The black-and-gold design and exclusive packaging make it as much a collector's piece as a match racket.

tech.name: Weight & Balance System
tech.text: Screw-in weights in the heart of the racket, adjusted with the included key, to move balance towards the head or the handle.

tech.name: Octagonal Structure
tech.text: Octagonal-section frame for more rigidity and power at impact.

tech.name: Diamond mould
tech.text: Head shape and high balance designed for maximum power.

tech.name: Aluminized carbon
tech.text: Carbon face treated for a lively, powerful response.

tech.name: EVA Soft Energy
tech.text: Softer EVA core that cushions contact.

faq.q: Is this the racket Ale Galán used?
faq.a: It is adidas's limited-edition Metalbone Master made for Ale Galán, in the black-and-gold colourway.
Yes. The Weight & Balance System uses screw-in weights and a key to move balance.

faq.q: Is it suitable for intermediate players?
faq.a: Strong intermediate+ players can handle it, but it is built for advanced players.

faq.q: Does it come with the box?
faq.a: Yes, it comes in the exclusive Metalbone Master presentation box.

data.clubTake: Brand new, unused, boxed. A rare one in Pune. Ask us to open the box at the desk if you want to see it in hand.
